title: Notabilia: self-denial; law as canon; Cap.19 next
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): CHAPTER NINETEEN follows, On Christian liberty. — 1. Zeal for good works necessarily includes self-denial and bearing ye cross. 2. What Christians must do, God's law perfectly shows as divine rule and canon; Christ stands as ye pattern. Without true knowledge belonging toward God they cannot be borne.
pass_b_english: 1. Zeal for good works necessarily includes self-denial and bearing the cross. 2. What Christians must do, God's law perfectly shows as divine rule and canon; Christ is the pattern. Without true knowledge of God they cannot be borne.
CHAPTER NINETEEN follows, On Christian liberty.
source_text: 1. Bonorum operum studium necessario includit sui ipsius abnegationem et crucis tolerantiam. 2. Quae Christianis facienda sint, lex Dei perfecte ostendit tanquam divina regula et canon; Christus exemplar. Sine vera Dei notitia ferri nequeunt. CAPUT DECIMUM NONUM sequitur, De libertate Christiana.
